title: Node Load Balancing
summary: Chooses which saved nodes take part in balancing and writes the balancer settings into Passwall. The status header shows the active mode and node count.

items.title: Select Nodes for Balancing
items.description: Numbers the saved configs and stores the ones you pick, skipping disabled configs automatically.
items.usage_tip: Enter node numbers separated by spaces, for example 1 3 4.

items.title: Set Balancing Mode
items.description: Chooses between round-robin, least-ping, failover and random distribution.
items.usage_tip: Failover is the safest choice for unstable links.

items.title: Apply Balancer to Passwall
items.description: Writes the selected mode and node list into Passwall and reloads the service.
items.usage_tip: Requires a saved mode and at least one selected node.

items.title: Disable Balancer
items.description: Removes the balancer section from Passwall and clears the saved mode and node list.
items.usage_tip: Use it to return to normal single-node proxy operation.

items.title: Back
items.description: Returns to the Proxy & Routing Manager.
items.usage_tip: Balancer settings stay as they are.
